tagline: GOMZ胶片单反相机，1937 年发布
description: GOMZ于1937年推出的胶片单反相机。配备Industar-10 1:3.5/50mm。快门速度Opening blade attached to the mirror; closing blade is a metal blade in the focal plane; speeds from 1/25 to 1/500 sec. Shutter cocked by advancing the film.。使用35mm in special cartridges taking 2m, enough for 50 exposures of 24×36mm。

specs.胶片/画幅: 35mm in special cartridges taking 2m, enough for 50 exposures of 24×36mm
specs.快门: Opening blade attached to the mirror; closing blade is a metal blade in the focal plane; speeds from 1/25 to 1/500 sec. Shutter cocked by advancing the film.
specs.取景器: SLR, looking into the finder at the top, and a direct vision optical viewfinder
specs.英文简介: The Sport (Cyrillic: "Спорт") is one of the two earliest SLR cameras using the 35mm film format, made by the Soviet camera manufacturer GOMZ, the other being the German Ihagee Kine Exakta.
